title: [Main]- Final sales invoice uses item Gen. Prod. Posting Group on prepayment deduction line
summary: Posting a final sales invoice no longer applies the item's Gen. Prod. Posting Group to the prepayment deduction line. The fix is in Sales-Post (codeunit 80) across all localized layers, with new prepayment tests.
key_points: Prepayment deduction lines on the final sales invoice no longer take the item's Gen. Prod. Posting Group
Applied in APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, FR, GB, IT, NA, NO, RU and W1 layers
Regression tests added to ERM Prepayment in W1 and RU
